doc_id -> {\"day\": int, \"recipients\": [...], \"is_canary\": bool, \"assignment\": {...}}\n        \"logs\": [],        # list of {\"day\": int, \"employee\": str, \"doc_id\": str, \"after_hours\": bool}\n        \"interviews\": [],  # list of {\"day\": int, \"employee\": str, \"topic\": str, \"evasive\": bool}\n        \"leaks\": [],       # list of {\"doc_id\": str, \"variant\": str or None}\n    }\n    with open(STATE_FILE, \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(state, f, indent=2)\n\ndef compute_posteriors(state):\n    log_p = {eid: 0.0 for eid in ALL_EIDS}\n    log_p[DECOY] = -1e9\n\n    # 1. Leaks\n    for leak in state[\"leaks\"]:\n        doc_id = leak[\"doc_id\"]\n        variant = leak.get(\"variant\")\n        doc = state[\"documents\"][doc_id]\n        rec = set(doc[\"recipients\"])\n        for eid in ALL_EIDS:\n            if eid not in rec:\n                log_p[eid] = -1e9\n        if doc[\"is_canary\"] and variant is not None:\n            assign = doc[\"assignment\"]\n            labels = set(assign.values())\n            n_other = len(labels) - 1\n            for eid in rec:\n                if log_p[eid] <= -1e8:\n                    continue\n                if assign[eid] == variant:\n                    log_p[eid] += math.log(0.95 if n_other > 0 else 1.0)\n                else:\n                    log_p[eid] += math.log(0.05 / n_other)\n\n    # 2. Interviews\n    for iv in state[\"interviews\"]:\n        eid = iv[\"employee\"]\n        if log_p[eid] <= -1e8:\n            continue\n        if iv[\"evasive\"]:\n            log_p[eid] += math.log(0.24 / 0.20)\n        else:\n            log_p[eid] += math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n\n    # 3. Access logs by day\n    days_seen = sorted(set(l[\"day\"] for l in state[\"logs\"]))\n    # Estimate non-decoy framing rate empirically or use conservative 0.135\n    total_non_decoy_ah = sum(1 for l in state[\"logs\"] if l[\"employee\"] != DECOY and l[\"after_hours\"])\n    # Expected per day: 38 * r_inn + 0.3\n    # Use r_inn = 0.135 (covers baseline 0.1263 and partial DSL random framing)\n    r_inn_ah = 0.135\n    r_inn_day = 0.90\n    r_mole_ah = 0.30\n    r_mole_day = 0.70\n\n    counts = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])  # (eid, day) -> [k_day, k_ah]\n    for l in state[\"logs\"]:\n        if l[\"after_hours\"]:\n            counts[(l[\"employee\"], l[\"day\"])][1] += 1\n        else:\n            counts[(l[\"employee\"], l[\"day\"])][0] += 1\n\n    for d in days_seen:\n        for eid in ALL_EIDS:\n            if log_p[eid] <= -1e8:\n                continue\n            k_day, k_ah = counts[(eid, d)]\n            llr = (\n                k_day * math.log(r_mole_day / r_inn_day) - (r_mole_day - r_inn_day)\n                + k_ah * math.log(r_mole_ah / r_inn_ah) - (r_mole_ah - r_inn_ah)\n            )\n            log_p[eid] += llr\n\n    mx = max(log_p.values())\n    probs = {eid: (math.exp(log_p[eid] - mx) if log_p[eid] > -1e8 else 0.0) for eid in ALL_EIDS}\n    s = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {eid: probs[eid] / s for eid in ALL_EIDS}\n    return probs\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    init_state()\n    print(\"Initialized state.\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/state.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/state.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/state.py","time":{"start":1794718325412,"end":1794718325431}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd8c5a5f001NEig5HM10o31XV","sessionID":"ses_e22797592ffesWMkxngPgb1bFc","messageID":"msg_1dd8ba564001ev3nTMjV1UHjQG"}}
